name: Editorial Newsroom
tagline: An editorial desk: a public front page over a draft-heavy store.
realWorld: Reporters draft, editors publish, and the public reads only what is published. Most of the store is not publicly visible, which is the point: the public reads are filtered and the desk reads are not.
